passives.name: Fused Test Subjects
passives.description: (Passive) If the caster has no Debuffs, WG damage taken is reduced by [Buff_V_4500350_4_2] and damage taken is reduced by [Buff_V_4500350_4_1]. When a Light or Dark enemy ends its action, removes all Debuffs from the caster and increases the caster’s Priority by [Buff_V_4500350_4_3_3]. At the start of each turn, increases the caster’s Penetration and Critical Hit Chance by 20%. (Stacks up to 4 times) Damage from Curse/Fixed Damage dealt to the boss cannot exceed [Buff_V_armor_common_3].

passives.name: Amorphous Subject
passives.description: (Passive Effect) If the caster does not have Freeze, damage taken is reduced by [Buff_V_4500350_5_1]. At the end of the turn, removes 1 debuff. When hit, Priority increases by [Buff_V_4500350_5_3_1].
